title: Data Analyst
text: Data Analyst at Family Planning Victoria (Melbourne, Eastern Suburbs; Part Time; salary: $69,000 + Superannuation and Salary Packaging). Are you an individual who has a keen interest in databases, analysis and reporting? About the role Family Planning Victoria is seeking an individual with demonstrated, highly developed consultation skills, who thrives on finding solutions through consultation with internal and external stakeholders in order to inform our services and strategies. You will be working with rich, intriguing data sets in order to inform and drive positive outcomes for the wider community in relation to reproductive and sexual health. What you would be doing The main things that you would be doing include: Leading identified data projects to strengthen service and data intelligence to inform decision making Developing external reports for relevant government bodies Producing reports for multiple levels of the organisation Providing statistical analysis Supporting research projects and evaluation through the provision and analysis of data Why apply? Reasons why we think this is a great role include: Great opportunity to influence the reproductive and sexual health outcomes for the wider Victorian community Flexible working conditions Great staff benefits including leave loading and discounted health insurance Learning and development opportunities Skills and experience We’re looking for candidates with the following skills and experience: Tertiary qualifications and/or equivalent experience in data management or statistics and/or a related discipline Sound ability to analyse database structure and query relational databases using Access Experience with SQL Server Management Studio Experience in the maintenance of a broad range of data processing documentation Demonstrated experience in project management Demonstrated experience in data management, analysis, reporting as well as supporting research and evaluation. Strong IT skills including SQL, reporting software, all MS Office applications, web-based databases and the internet with a strong conceptual ability to learn new software applications quickly. Experience in a health or education related organisation, desirable Experience with VETtrak and Best Practice software, desirable The incumbent will also be required to undertake and complete a Satisfactory National Police Check and will hold a valid Working with Children Check. About Family Planning Victoria As a leading, not for profit, state-wide provider of reproductive and sexual health care, education and advocacy, Family Planning Victoria is governed by a voluntary board of directors. We have been providing comprehensive reproductive and sexual health services in Victoria for over 45 years. How to apply To apply, please email your application with a cover letter addressing the key selection criteria via the APPLY button, To view the position description, please visit https://www.fpv.org.au/careers/career-opportunities Applications close 13th May 2018. Please note, applications from agencies will not be considered. Applications not addressing the key selection criteria will not be considered. We welcome applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, workers of all ages, people with disabilities, people who identify as LGBTIQ and those from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds.
